title: MenuAI Standard Pipeline Metadata
description: Per-image metadata attached to a Standard-pipeline processing result (spec §8), extended with the Segmentation Gate outcome (spec §3) since that stage can stop processing before the Integrity Validator ever runs.

policy_version.description: Version of the immutable Integrity Validator policy artifact (§6, §11 step 3).

policy_hash.description: sha256 digest of the policy YAML file the validator ran against - pins it as an immutable artifact (§6).

segmentation_status.description: Outcome of the Segmentation Gate (§3), the first checkpoint. Not part of the original §8 schema - added so a caller can tell an early gate stop apart from a later validator REVIEW/REJECT.

is_infra_error.description: True only when segmentation_status is REJECT because the segmentation backend itself failed (model load error, inference crash/OOM after exhausting its own same-parameters infra retries) rather than because the photo is unsupported. Lets a caller (e.g. Laravel) show a different message - '일시적 오류, 잠시 후 다시 시도해주세요' vs '이 사진은 지원되지 않습니다' - without a separate top-level status value; see standard/segmentation/README.md. Always false when segmentation_status is not REJECT.

validator_status.description: Outcome of the Integrity Validator's 4 modules (§6), after the Retry state machine has resolved any initial REJECT down to PASS or REVIEW (§7's final_action - a REJECT here would mean the Retry state machine itself is broken, not a normal outcome). null when segmentation_status is REJECT - the validator never ran.

retry_attempts_used.description: How many Retry state machine attempts it took to resolve the Validator's initial verdict (0 if it PASSed immediately, or if segmentation REJECTed before the Validator ran).

merchant_review.description: Merchant's own sign-off (§7) - deliberately a separate field from validator_status/segmentation_status, never merged into one status (§7: 'food_integrity_check와 merchant_review는 절대 하나로 합치지 않는다').

reasonCode.description: standard.reason_codes.ReasonCode - keep this enum in sync with ai-service/standard/reason_codes.py.
